            theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.VertexRepresentation.isClosed_kingPoint {k R I J : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] (b : Module.Basis J k R) {d : I → ℕ} {e : I → R} (w : I → ℤ) (x : VertexRepresentation d e) (h : ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : 0 < m) (f : KingPiece b d e w m), ↑↑f x ≠ 0) :
            IsClosed {kingPoint b w x h}

            The evaluation point is closed. Any relevant homogeneous prime containing the evaluation kernel omits a positive-degree form. Comparing powers of that form with any other form of nonzero value forces the latter to be omitted too.
